```lean
import VeriSlopBridgeGoal

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 20000000

namespace VeriSlopBridgeProof

open VeriSlopBridgeGoal

abbrev RawEvent := String × (Int × (Option Int × Unit))
abbrev RawStats := Nat × (Int × Unit)
abbrev RawRow := String × (Int × (Nat × (Option Int × Unit)))
abbrev RawState := Option Int × (List RawRow × Unit)

def statsAdapter :
    VSCore3.Adapter VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_0_result VeriSlopAST.Stats where
  to s := (s.count, (s.sum, ()))
  inv s := ⟨s.1, s.2.1⟩
  from_to := by intro s; cases s; rfl
  to_from := by
    intro s
    rcases s with ⟨n, v, u⟩
    cases u
    rfl

def stateAdapter :
    VSCore3.Adapter
      (.record "State" ["previous", "rows"]
        (.product (.option .int)
          (.product VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_1_result .unit)))
      VeriSlopAST.State where
  to s := (s.previous, (adapter_9.to s.rows, ()))
  inv s := ⟨s.1, adapter_9.inv s.2.1⟩
  from_to := by
    intro s
    cases s
    simp only [adapter_9.from_to]
  to_from := by
    intro s
    rcases s with ⟨p, rs, u⟩
    cases u
    simp only [adapter_9.to_from]

theorem fold_to
    {t u : VSCore3.Shape} {A B : Type}
    (a : VSCore3.Adapter t A) (b : VSCore3.Adapter u B)
    (f : B → A → B)
    (g : VSCore3.Denote u → VSCore3.Denote t → VSCore3.Denote u)
    (h : ∀ z x, g (b.to z) (a.to x) = b.to (f z x))
    (z : B) (xs : List A) :
    List.foldl g (b.to z) ((VSCore3.listAdapter a).to xs) =
      b.to (List.foldl f z xs) := by
  have ht := congrArg b.to
    (VSCore3.ProofSupport.foldl_transport a b f g h z xs)
  simpa only [b.to_from] using ht

def rawAggregateStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String) (time : Int)
    (s : RawStats) (e : RawEvent) : RawStats :=
  if decide (e.1 = group) &&
      (decide (time ≤ e.2.1) &&
        (decide (e.2.1 < time + i.width) &&
          decide (e.2.1 < i.«end»))) then
    Option.casesOn e.2.2.1 s
      (fun v => (s.1 + 1, (s.2.1 + v, ())))
  else s

def aggregateStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String) (time : Int)
    (s : VeriSlopAST.Stats) (e : VeriSlopAST.Event) : VeriSlopAST.Stats :=
  cond
    (decide (e.group = group) &&
      (e.value.isSome &&
        decide (time ≤ e.time ∧
          (e.time < time + i.width ∧ e.time < i.«end»))))
    ⟨s.count + 1, s.sum + e.value.getD 0⟩ s

theorem aggregate_step_agrees
    (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String) (time : Int)
    (s : VeriSlopAST.Stats) (e : VeriSlopAST.Event) :
    rawAggregateStep i group time (statsAdapter.to s) (adapter_3.to e) =
      statsAdapter.to (aggregateStep i group time s e) := by
  cases hv : e.value <;>
    by_cases hg : e.group = group <;>
    by_cases hl : time ≤ e.time <;>
    by_cases hu : e.time < time + i.width <;>
    by_cases he : e.time < i.«end» <;>
    simp [rawAggregateStep, aggregateStep, statsAdapter,
      adapter_3, adapter_0, adapter_1, adapter_2,
      VSCore3.stringAdapter, VSCore3.intAdapter, VSCore3.optionAdapter,
      hv, hg, hl, hu, he]

theorem aggregate_eq
    (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String) (time : Int) :
    VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_0_named (adapter_6.to i) group time =
      statsAdapter.to (VeriSlopAST.aggregate i group time) := by
  with_unfolding_all
    change
      List.foldl (rawAggregateStep i group time)
        (statsAdapter.to (VeriSlopAST.Stats.mk 0 0))
        ((VSCore3.listAdapter adapter_3).to i.events) =
      statsAdapter.to (List.foldl (aggregateStep i group time)
        (VeriSlopAST.Stats.mk 0 0) i.events)
  exact fold_to adapter_3 statsAdapter
    (aggregateStep i group time) (rawAggregateStep i group time)
    (aggregate_step_agrees i group time) ⟨0, 0⟩ i.events

def bucketCount (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) : Nat :=
  Int.toNat (Int.fdiv (i.«end» - i.start + i.width - 1) i.width)

def bucketTime (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (n : Nat) : Int :=
  i.start + Int.ofNat n * i.width

def rawFillPrevious (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) : Bool :=
  letI := VSCore3.denoteDecidableEq (.enum "Fill" ["none", "previous"])
  decide (adapter_5.to i.fill =
    (⟨"previous", by decide +kernel⟩ :
      VSCore3.Denote (.enum "Fill" ["none", "previous"])))

theorem fill_previous_eq (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) :
    rawFillPrevious i = decide (i.fill = VeriSlopAST.Fill.previous) := by
  cases hf : i.fill <;>
    simp [rawFillPrevious, hf, adapter_5, VSCore3.denoteDecidableEq]

def rawGroupStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String)
    (s : RawState) (n : Nat) : RawState :=
  let time := bucketTime i n
  let a := VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_0_named (adapter_6.to i) group time
  (if decide (0 < a.1) then some a.2.1 else s.1,
    (s.2.1 ++
      [(group, (time, (a.1,
        (if decide (0 < a.1) then some a.2.1
         else if rawFillPrevious i then s.1 else none, ()))))],
      ()))

def groupStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String)
    (s : VeriSlopAST.State) (n : Nat) : VeriSlopAST.State :=
  let time := bucketTime i n
  let a := VeriSlopAST.aggregate i group time
  ⟨cond (decide (0 < a.count)) (some a.sum) s.previous,
    s.rows ++
      [⟨group, time, a.count,
        cond (decide (0 < a.count)) (some a.sum)
          (cond (decide (i.fill = VeriSlopAST.Fill.previous))
            s.previous none)⟩]⟩

theorem group_step_agrees
    (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String)
    (s : VeriSlopAST.State) (n : Nat) :
    rawGroupStep i group (stateAdapter.to s) (adapter_7.to n) =
      stateAdapter.to (groupStep i group s n) := by
  by_cases hc : 0 < (VeriSlopAST.aggregate i group (bucketTime i n)).count <;>
    cases hf : i.fill <;>
    simp [rawGroupStep, groupStep, stateAdapter, aggregate_eq,
      statsAdapter, fill_previous_eq, hc, hf,
      adapter_9, adapter_8, adapter_7, adapter_2, adapter_1, adapter_0,
      VSCore3.listAdapter, VSCore3.natAdapter, VSCore3.optionAdapter,
      VSCore3.intAdapter, VSCore3.stringAdapter, List.map_append]

theorem group_eq (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) (group : String) :
    VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_1_named (adapter_6.to i) group =
      adapter_9.to (VeriSlopAST.group_rows i group) := by
  have ht := fold_to adapter_7 stateAdapter
    (groupStep i group) (rawGroupStep i group)
    (group_step_agrees i group)
    (VeriSlopAST.State.mk none []) (List.range (bucketCount i))
  have hp := congrArg (fun s : RawState => s.2.1) ht
  simp only [VSCore3.listAdapter, adapter_7, VSCore3.natAdapter,
    VSCore3.ProofSupport.map_identity] at hp
  with_unfolding_all
    change
      (List.foldl (rawGroupStep i group)
        (stateAdapter.to (VeriSlopAST.State.mk none []))
        (List.range (bucketCount i))).2.1 =
      adapter_9.to (VeriSlopAST.group_rows i group)
  change
    (List.foldl (rawGroupStep i group)
      (stateAdapter.to (VeriSlopAST.State.mk none []))
      (List.range (bucketCount i))).2.1 =
    adapter_9.to (VeriSlopAST.group_rows i group) at hp
  exact hp

theorem groups_eq (i : VeriSlopAST.Input) :
    (i.events.map adapter_3.to).map (fun e => e.1) =
      i.events.map VeriSlopAST.Event.group := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, adapter_3, adapter_0,
    VSCore3.stringAdapter]

def rawSolveStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input)
    (rows : List RawRow) (group : String) : List RawRow :=
  rows ++ VeriSlopReadableSource.helper_1_named (adapter_6.to i) group

def solveStep (i : VeriSlopAST.Input)
    (rows : List VeriSlopAST.Row) (group : String) : List VeriSlopAST.Row :=
  rows ++ VeriSlopAST.group_rows i group

theorem solve_step_agrees (i : VeriSlopAST.Input)
    (rows : List VeriSlopAST.Row) (group : String) :
    rawSolveStep i (adapter_9.to rows) (adapter_0.to group) =
      adapter_9.to (solveStep i rows group) := by
  simp only [rawSolveStep, solveStep, adapter_0, VSCore3.stringAdapter,
    group_eq, adapter_9, VSCore3.listAdapter, List.map_append]

theorem refines : Refines_solve := by
  intro i
  rw [VeriSlopBridgeGoal.Readable.source_eq_solve]
  with_unfolding_all
    change
      adapter_9.inv
        (List.foldl (rawSolveStep i) []
          (List.mergeSort
            (List.eraseDups
              ((i.events.map adapter_3.to).map (fun e => e.1)))
            (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b)))) =
      VeriSlopAST.solve i
  rw [groups_eq]
  have ht := VSCore3.ProofSupport.foldl_transport adapter_0 adapter_9
    (solveStep i) (rawSolveStep i) (solve_step_agrees i) []
    (List.mergeSort (List.eraseDups (i.events.map VeriSlopAST.Event.group))
      (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b)))
  simp only [VSCore3.listAdapter, adapter_0, VSCore3.stringAdapter,
    VSCore3.ProofSupport.map_identity] at ht
  change
    adapter_9.inv
      (List.foldl (rawSolveStep i) []
        (List.mergeSort (List.eraseDups (i.events.map VeriSlopAST.Event.group))
          (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b)))) =
    VeriSlopAST.solve i at ht
  exact ht

theorem edge : VeriSlopBridgeGoal.EdgeProp :=
  VeriSlopBridgeGoal.edge_of_refines refines

end VeriSlopBridgeProof
```
